HB Velo Sunday Morning Shop Ride

Huntington Beach, CA · Road

HB Velo Sunday Morning Shop Ride is a road group ride in Huntington Beach, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 8:05 am from HB Velo Cyclery. About 25–70 miles, 18 mph average.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:05 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at @hbvelocyclery the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the HB Velo Sunday Morning Shop Ride group ride

Fast Sunday shop ride out of HB Velo, 25 to 70 miles at about 18 mph. The Wednesday and Friday coffee rides are the easier option at 15 mph and about 25 miles. Ride updates are posted on the shop's Facebook page.
